welcome.title: Never miss a dose
welcome.body: Reminders for your medicines and your family's, right on time. Before or after meals, with Taken and Skip in the notification.

onboarding.name: Your name
onboarding.yourDayHint: No reminders while you sleep; the morning note comes when you wake up.
onboarding.disclaimer: This app reminds you; it doesn't give medical advice. Always follow your doctor's instructions.

validation.couldNotSave: Could not save. Please try again.
validation.endBeforeStart: The last day can't be before the start
validation.stockNumbers: Enter how many are left and when to warn
validation.wakeSleepSame: Wake and sleep times must differ
validation.tooManyMembers: You can add up to 10 people
validation.unknownMedicine: That medicine is no longer in your list.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartBody: Close and reopen the app so the layout can switch direction for this language.

themeHints.dark: Easy on the eyes at night

settings.feedbackHint: Ideas, problems or a missing language
settings.rateHint: Enjoying it? A rating helps a lot
settings.shareMessage: I use Medicine Reminder so I never miss a dose. Try it:
settings.tagline: Made to help you and your family take every dose on time.
settings.languageIntro: Choose the language for the whole app. New languages download on their own.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.toggleHint: Remind me when it's time for a medicine
reminders.toneCaption: Choosing a tone plays a preview notification.
reminders.dailyReportsHint: When you wake up: how many doses today and when the first is
reminders.takeOnTimeHint: Taken opens 1 hour before a dose, or from the start of its part of the day for doses with a meal. Skip always works.
reminders.dayParts: When each part of the day starts, for doses taken with a meal.
reminders.dayPartsOrder: Morning, afternoon and night need to be in that order.

permissions.blockedBody: Notifications are off for Medicine Reminder, so no reminders will arrive.
permissions.lateBody: Allow “Alarms & reminders” so they arrive on time.
permissions.batteryBody: Some phones pause apps in the background to save battery. Letting Medicine Reminder run unrestricted keeps reminders on time.

dose.title: Time for your medicine 💊
dose.refillBody_one: Only {{count}} dose left. Time to refill.
dose.refillBody_other: Only {{count}} doses left. Time to refill.
dose.outBody: None left to take. Once you refill, update the count in Medicines.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Your data is safe on this phone. Try again in a moment.
error.crash: The app hit a problem. Your medicines and settings are safe on this phone.

languageSync.failed: Couldn’t check for new translations. Using the saved ones.

ads.offerBody: Watch a short video and get {{hours}} more hours without ads. It adds up: every video adds {{hours}} hours.
ads.notFinished: Watch the video to the end to hide ads.
ads.unavailable: No video right now. Please try again later.
ads.label: Advertisement
ads.extendBody: Watch a short video and {{hours}} hours are added to your ad-free time. Videos add up: watch as many as you like.
ads.welcomeBody: Thanks for joining! Watch one short video to the end and enjoy Medicine Reminder for {{hours}} hours without ads.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell me what works, what doesn't, or what you'd like next. I read every message.
feedback.name: Name
feedback.emailHelper: Only if you'd like a reply.
feedback.queued: You're offline. Your feedback will send when you're back online.

update.requiredBody: This version of Medicine Reminder is no longer supported. Update to keep getting your medicine reminders.
update.availableBody: Update Medicine Reminder to get the latest improvements and fixes.
update.failed: Couldn't open the update. Try again, or update from the store.
update.notReady: The update isn't ready to download yet. Please try again later.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Everything still works. Your medicines and doses are saved on this phone.

adFree.body: Enjoy Medicine Reminder without ads until {{date}}. Thanks for joining!
adFree.video: No worries after that: watch a short video any time for {{hours}} more hours without ads.

languageMissing.title: Can't find your language?
languageMissing.body: No worries: tell us through feedback and we'll add it as soon as possible.

meals.title: Meal times
meals.hint: Doses before or after a meal follow these times.

today.title: Today
today.allDone: All done for today. Well done!
today.emptyBody: Add a medicine and its times; reminders come on their own.
today.noneTodayBody: None of your medicines is due today.
today.outBody: The count says none are left. Bought more? Enter how many you have now.

medicine.forWhomHint: Pick one or more people. Each gets their own reminders and count.
medicine.name: Medicine name
medicine.hasEndHint: For a course, e.g. 7 days of antibiotics
medicine.trackStockHint: Warns you before it runs out
medicine.notesPlaceholder: e.g. take with water, don't crush
medicine.deleteBody: It's removed for everyone who takes it, with their reminders and history.

members.title: Family
members.hint: Add the people whose medicines you look after. Their reminders say whose medicine it is.
members.name: Name
members.removeBody: {{name}}'s medicines and history are removed too.

medicines.noneFor: No medicines for this person yet

assign.title: Assign {{name}}
assign.promptBody: Assign it to yourself or a family member to get reminders.
assign.noneYetBody: Assign it to someone to get reminders for it.
assign.removeBody: Their reminders and history for it are removed. The medicine stays in your list.

insights.title: Medicine Guide
insights.emptyBody: New tips about taking medicines well will show up here. Pull down to check again.
insights.offline: Couldn't load stories. Check your connection.
insights.disclaimer: General health information, not medical advice. Always follow your doctor's or pharmacist's advice.
insights.notFound: This story is no longer available.
